items.q: The Turkish name for a hymn praising Allah, sung in mosques and Sufi gatherings.
The Turkish name for a poem praising our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, from the Arabic word for describing.
The Anatolian Sufi poet of the 7th-8th century AH whose simple Turkish poems are still sung as ilahis.
The Turkish word for the Mawlid poem, read at births, deaths and holy nights.
The poet of Bursa who wrote the most famous Turkish Mevlid, "Vesiletü'n-Necat".
"Vesiletü'n-Necat", the title of Süleyman Çelebi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ Mevlid, means this.
The section of the Turkish Mevlid on the blessed birth is named after this word of welcome, repeated in its verses.
The Turkish name for the five holy nights when minarets are lit, from the word for an oil lamp.
The Ottoman Turkish name for a written description of our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ features, often framed as calligraphy.
The Ramadan message in lights strung between two minarets, an Ottoman tradition.
The Ottoman composer who set the famous Na't-ı Şerif sung at the start of the Mevlevi ceremony.
The words of the Na't-ı Şerif set by Itri ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ are by this great poet of Konya.
items.a: Mawlana Jalal al-Din Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩

items.q: The Ottoman calligrapher who set the standard layout of the calligraphic hilye panel.
The Ottoman poet who wrote the best-known hilye in Turkish verse, "Hilye-i Hakani".
The Ottoman Sufi of Üsküdar, founder of the Celveti way, whose ilahis are still sung.
The Anatolian Sufi of İznik who wrote "Müzekki'n-Nüfus" and many ilahis.
The call from the minaret with blessings on our Beloved Prophet ﷺ before the Friday prayer or to announce a death.
The hymns sung from the minarets in the night hours of the holy months, in the Ottoman tradition.
The Bosnian name for ilahis, sung with "kaside" in Bosnia.
Süleyman Çelebi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ finished his Mevlid in this year.
Süleyman Çelebi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
The Mevlid is traditionally read on the night of this date, the blessed birthday, in Rabi' al-Awwal.
A Mevlid is often read on this day after a person's death.
The Kandil night of the blessed birth of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The Kandil night of the Night Journey and Ascension.
The Kandil night in the middle of Sha'ban.
The Kandil night before the first Friday of Rajab.
Yunus Emre's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ famous ilahi addresses this creaking machine and asks why it moans.
Itri ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
Hafız Osman ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
Aziz Mahmud Hüdayi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
The musical mode (makam) of Itri's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ famous Na't-ı Şerif.
The Ottoman genre of hymn of the Halveti way, sung slowly and solemnly.
The Turkish word for the Sufi lodge where ilahis were sung in dhikr gatherings.
Yunus Emre's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ long didactic poem in mathnawi form, written in 707 AH / 1307-08 CE.
The Bosnian poet of Žepče who wrote ilahije in Bosnian with Arabic letters and was executed in Travnik.
The way of writing Bosnian in Arabic letters, used for ilahije and kaside.
Hafız Osman's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ hilye layout carries the verse calling our Beloved Prophet ﷺ a mercy to the worlds, from this surah.
The meter of Süleyman Çelebi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ Mevlid, the same as Rumi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ Mathnawi.
Abdulvehab Ilhamija ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ was executed in this year.
Hakani Mehmed Bey ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
The Bosnian pilgrimage in June to a rock where a spring is said to have opened after forty days of prayer.
Yunus Emre's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ poems are gathered in this kind of book.
Hafız Osman ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ learned calligraphy from this master, among others.
Hacı Bayram Veli ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, whose poem likens the heart to a city built by Allah, is buried in this city.
The fifth Kandil night, kept on the 27th night of Ramadan by custom.
The ilahi-like hymns sung between the parts of the Mevlid.
Süleyman Çelebi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ was imam of this mosque in Bursa, by the common report.

items.q: The famous Turkish takbir of the Eid days is often credited to this composer.
items.src: Standard reference; the credit is traditional
